name: spring-boot-skill
description: Build Spring Boot 4.x applications following the best practices. Use this skill: * When developing Spring Boot applications using Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Modulith, Spring Security * To create recommended Spring Boot package structure * To implement REST APIs, entities/repositories, service layer, modular monoliths * To use Thymeleaf view templates for building web applications * To write tests for REST APIs and Web applications * To write ArchUnit tests for testing architecture * To configure the recommended plugins and configurations to improve code quality, and testing while using Maven. * To use Spring Boot's Docker Compose support for local development * To create Taskfile for easier execution of common tasks while working with a Spring Boot application
